items.headline: Snowflake reports Q1 FY2027 results with 34% YoY product revenue growth and raises full-year product revenue guidance to $5.84 billion
Snowflake signs $6 billion multi-year strategic collaboration agreement with AWS to accelerate enterprise generative and agentic AI adoption
Snowflake announces intent to acquire Natoma, an enterprise Model Context Protocol platform to enhance secure connectivity for AI agents
